content: खः The sun. .{@-खम्@} .²1 The sky; खं केशवोऽपर इवाक्रमितुं प्रवृत्तः <ls>Mk. 5. 2</ls>; यावद्गिरः खे मरुतां चरन्ति <ls>Ku. 3. 72</ls>; <ls>Me. 9</ls>. .²2 Heaven. .²3 Organ of sense; पराञ्चि खानि व्यतृणत्स्वयंभूस्तमात्पराङ् पश्यति नान्तरात्मन् <ls>Kaṭh. 2. 1. 1</ls>. .²4 A city. .²5 A field. .²6 A cypher. .²7 A dot, an anusvāra. .²8 A cavity, an aperture, hollow, hole; नश्यतीषुर्यथा विद्धः खे विद्धमनुविध्यतः <ls>Ms. 9. 43</ls>. .²9 An aperture of the human body; (of which there are 9, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} the mouth, the two ears, the two eyes, the two nostrils, and the organs of excretion and generation); खानि चैव स्पृशेदद्भिः <ls>Ms. 2. 60</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 2.">53</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">4. 144</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 20</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ku. 3. 50</ls>. .²10 A wound. .²11 Happiness, pleasure. .²12 Tale. .²13 Action. .²14 Knowledge. .²15 Brahman. .²16 The glottis (in anatomy). .²17 The tenth mansion from any given constellation or the sunʼs entrance into it. .{@-खा@} .²1 A well, fountain. .²2 A river. .²3 Pārvatī. .²4 The earth. .²5 Lakṣmi. .²6 The speech; <ab>cf.</ab> खोमा क्ष्मा कमला च गीः <ls>Enm.</ls>
